descriptions.d11b_selection_event_void_8029e02c: Dispatch unsigned 16-bit event IDs 64 and 66 to setup/reset, preserving signed base-handler failure and HRESULT 0x80004005. For other IDs, require current context and all observed global/owner/configuration guards before matching previous/next cached IDs and applying the original single-precision slider step. Otherwise forward through the secondary base and return the root handler result. Preserve guard order, live reloads, message-cache identities and callback arguments. Partial owner/configuration views; no complete sizeof claim. No owned initialized data. Forward helper uses the independently inspected void return declaration. Supersedes withdrawn d11b_selection_event_8029e02c without editing its artifacts.
